collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: After a large village gathering, a villager wonders whether people in enormous places never meet their neighbors.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After a large village gathering, (name1) wonders whether people living in enormous places might never meet the people next door.

choices.label: Imagine Strangers Living Side by Side.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The villager finds the thought lonely.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Another villager finds it peaceful and admits they would sometimes like a little more privacy.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A parent imagines neighbors in a vast place sharing food and watching each other's children, just like here.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A skeptic says closeness might be harder, and nobody can prove them wrong.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The villager visits a neighbor they rarely speak to, and they talk for an hour.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The neighbor is busy, but they promise to share supper soon.
